correctness.rationale: For fixed zero-index sets, the least excess needed on each side is derived exactly by distinguishing a common-positive defender from the only alternative, two inside-index defenders. Substitution into the total weight gives an exact support-level optimization. Its equality cases yield one odd pattern and five even patterns; equality also forces one strong defender per side and all other positive labels to be 1. Direct exhaustive enumeration for \(n=3,4,5\) matches the classification exactly, and an independent parameter scan through \(n=50\) confirms the equality-pattern reduction. The infinite result relies on the written parity proof, not on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The claim determines the entire optimal solution space for a canonical dense regular bipartite family, not just another scalar evaluation. It exposes five even-order support geometries and an exact cubic optimizer count versus a rigid \(n\)-element odd-order family. This structure is useful for symmetry-aware enumeration and exact-algorithm benchmarks and is not implied by the already known minimum value.
